title: Public debt and monetary policy transmission: evidence from advanced and emerging Europe

facts.cause: High public debt changes how tighter monetary policy transmits through the economy.

facts.subject: Public debt at intermediate maturities
facts.cause: The maturity structure of public debt affects monetary policy transmission.

facts.cause: The maturity structure of public debt affects monetary policy transmission.

title: II. High public debt and shifting financial markets: challenges for central banks

facts.claim: The BIS said public debt in many economies has risen to near post-World War II highs.
facts.subject: Public debt in many economies
facts.cause: The Great Financial Crisis, the Covid-19 pandemic and other major shocks over the past two decades.

facts.claim: The BIS said the combination of near-record high public debt and the growing role of non-banks in sovereign debt markets amplifies and accelerates the transmission of market stress.
facts.subject: Sovereign debt markets
facts.cause: Near-record high public debt and a growing role for non-banks in sovereign debt markets.

facts.claim: The BIS said more frequent and sharper shifts in sovereign bond values can tighten financial conditions quickly.
facts.subject: Sovereign bond values
facts.cause: Fiscal risk repricing and non-bank deleveraging can amplify market stress.

facts.claim: The BIS said high public debt can make monetary policy transmission more complex and uncertain.
facts.subject: High public debt
facts.cause: Rate hikes can raise government interest payments, support demand and also worsen the fiscal outlook.

facts.claim: The BIS said central banks may need to intervene more often to address dysfunction in repo and government bond markets.
facts.subject: Central banks
facts.cause: High public debt and financial fragility can make market dysfunction more frequent.

facts.claim: The BIS said governments with high debt levels need credible medium-term fiscal frameworks to ensure fiscal consolidation takes place.
facts.subject: High-debt governments
facts.cause: Lasting success depends on sound fiscal and financial foundations.
